sources.name: USGS 3DEP LiDAR block points (every return; vegetation, ground, roof heights)

sources.licence: per-field sources in houses.json (public domain / ODbL / CDLA)

sources.name: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 (annual/seasonal), nearest station
Weather triggers: NOAA NCEI Storm Events, NWS warnings (IEM), EPA AQS PM10 (weather_triggers.json)
earth_county.json: EPA Map of Radon Zones, USGS NURE gamma (eU), EPA AQS design values (PM2.5, O3)
EarthScope Consortium / NSF GAGE GNSS station velocities (nearest station vertical)
USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SSURGO) linear extensibility (shrink-swell)
Pool sites + yearly states (usa/pools.py on USDA NAIP) and pool_service.json
Block streets.json road surfaces (LiDAR ground + OpenStreetMap)

trades.label: Roofing
trades.blurb: Hail history, roof age clues, roof surface deviation from fitted planes, height, sun exposure, snow-melt test.

trades.label: Gutters
trades.blurb: LiDAR vegetation above the eave within 3 m of the roof edge, and roof-edge length to clean.

trades.label: Tree care
trades.blurb: LiDAR canopy over the roof, tallest tree within 10 m, trees tall enough to reach the house if they fell.

trades.label: Leaf clean-up (frontage)
trades.blurb: LiDAR canopy over the strip between the house and the street.

trades.label: Snow and ice
trades.blurb: Station snowfall normals, ground in the house's winter noon shadow, snow-melt apron flag.

trades.label: Heating
trades.blurb: Heating degree-days, home age, faster-melting roof flag.

trades.label: Cooling
trades.blurb: Cooling degree-days, facade and roof sun hours, summer surface temperature, home age.

trades.label: Solar panel cleaning
trades.blurb: Solar permit on record, dust days, PM2.5, canopy over the roof.

trades.label: Pressure washing
trades.blurb: Shaded facades (low sun hours), canopy beside the house, dust days, PM2.5.

trades.label: Foundation
trades.blurb: Nearest GNSS vertical velocity, soil shrink-swell (SSURGO LEP), FEMA flood zone.

trades.label: Drainage and flood
trades.blurb: FEMA flood zone and the house's ground height versus the lowest ground nearby (LiDAR).

trades.label: Radon
trades.blurb: EPA county radon zone and USGS NURE equivalent uranium.

trades.label: Pest control
trades.blurb: NWI wetlands within 300 m, green-pool history in the block, canopy around the house.

trades.label: Defensible space
trades.blurb: LiDAR vegetation cover in the 0-1.5 m, 1.5-9 m and 9-30 m zones around the house.

trades.label: Pool service
trades.blurb: Copied from pool_service.json (lane PS1) when present.
